name: shortbow
lore_template: A {material_name} shortbow. Quick to draw, light in the hand.
design_notes: v2 chain rebalance: finesse class, 5 rungs. Midpoint rung 3 = 1.00× (1.0× anchor band). Peak rung 5 = 3.00×. Class mechanic: Ranged precision: critical hits on natural 19-20. (see weapon_class_chain + class_mechanic fields). damage_modifier 0.8 preserved from v1; weapon_base_damage now anchored on curve.weapon_base_damage(min_level) (2.4× higher than v1 due to midpoint=1.0× re-anchor).
class_mechanic_desc: At max chain: ignores 50% of target's armor. A drawn shortbow at close range was the Mongol horse-archer's answer to mail.
